native_compatibility: No diff against baseline in csrc, cmake, CMakeLists.txt, pyproject.toml, vllm/_custom_ops.py, rust, or setup.py
configuration: eager, TP=PP=DP=1, async scheduling, 9 physical blocks including null, block size 16
connector: MultiConnector producer with a consumer child derived from the upstream LoadRecoveryExampleConnector
injection: Drop owner's synchronous 112-token external KV load; run real model forwards and cancel owner before draining its queued result
baseline_mrv2_recompute_limit: An initial unbounded trial produced CUDA illegal memory access after the wrong rewind; repeated attribution probes cancel the unrelated request immediately after observing that rewind. Their model-output comparison is intentionally null.
scope: Controlled fault injection using a reference connector; not a survey of production connectors. Producer throughput and latency impact is unmeasured.
